title: Clarinetists Zeb and Watson; the band at Pete Herman's
summary: Handy praises the clarinetists Zeb and Watson, then lists the band he had at Pete Herman's with Ridgely, Shots and Emma Barrett.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: No, Zeb's dead. The guy I really liked to hear play clarinet. He played such a sweet clarinet. It was, uh, a fellow by the name of Watson. Used to play with Sam Morgan. I used to like to hear him play clarinet. And he used to like to hear me play. Because the OAC, he wanted me to blow. And I, you know, I'd just rather hear him play than play myself. He didn't make so much, but what he made was so pretty and clean. Real fine clarinet player. I went down to, uh, Pete Herman's. Played down there with, uh, Bebe Ridgely. Uh huh. At that time, I had, uh, John Porter on bass. Arthur Williams on drums. Shots on trumpet. Bebe on trombone. Uh, Emma Barrett on piano. Uh, it was old after.
